symptom: Found fixing ako/mxcli#1743: an input widget's Studio Pro 'On enter' / 'On leave' actions (focus in / out; OnEnterAction / OnLeaveAction on Forms$TextBox, TextArea, DatePicker, CheckBox, RadioButtonGroup, DropDown) had no MDL property and were deleted by describe -> exec of a Studio Pro page. Measured on 11.13.0: a page holding seven of them described with none, exec reported 'Replaced page', all seven were gone, mx check 0 errors
cause: widgetToGen hard-coded SetOnEnterAction(noActionGen()) / SetOnLeaveAction(noActionGen()) on every input (only the text box's OnEnterAction read a model field, which no builder ever set), describe never read either slot, and the #721 L2 carry (carryNoActionExecution) copies DisabledDuringExecution between two NoActions only — a stored action meets a rebuilt NoAction and is skipped
file: mdl/backend/modelsdk/widget_write.go (focusEventsToGen, every input case), widget_write_legacy_gaps.go (dropDownToGen); mdl/executor/input_event_actions.go (OnEnter / OnLeave rows, applyInputFocusEventsV3 called by all six input builders); mdl/executor/widget_native_props.go (inputReads); cmd_pages_describe_parse.go / cmd_pages_describe_output.go (extractFocusEventActions, appendFocusEventProps)
fix: `OnEnter:` / `OnLeave:` (stored names `OnEnterAction:` / `OnLeaveAction:` accepted) on all six inputs, through the same table as `OnEnterKeyPress:`; written by focusEventsToGen, described back after OnChange. describe -> exec of the 7-action page: 'Unchanged page', mx check 0 errors
insight: #721 L2 looked at these slots and fixed only the flag on the empty ones, because the stored population it measured was all NoActions — a slot that is empty in every fixture still needs a spelling if Studio Pro lets an author fill it, or the first page that does fill it is deleted by a rewrite. When a writer sets a slot to a constant, ask whether Studio Pro can put something else there, not whether the fixtures happen to. The cheapest control is the build before the fix run over a page written by the build after it: describe -> exec with the old binary showed the loss in one command, where a stored Studio Pro example would have had to be found first. 'On enter' is the focus event, not the Enter key, which is why the two spellings stay distinct (OnEnter vs OnEnterKeyPress)
